newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly flat to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices remained mostly flat to weaker on Friday in listless activity, dealers said.
Dealers cited thin volume. One North Carolina dealer said the market was killing time before new crop wheat moves which would put some pressure on midd prices.
Also, the market continued to shrug off the recent gains in soybean prices.
"There is nothing significant," a Kansas dealer said.
"The market is comfortable. They are comfortable supply-and-demand-wise and comfortable price-wise," a St Louis dealer said.
He added there was is no incentive to sell (midds) cheap or to load up on them.
"There is no incentive to more buy more than you think you need, or to hold off," he said.
